description: Reads the persona of one AI assistant, named by id (an automation of this workspace that has an AI step): business name, what the business does, tone, whether it may quote prices, the links it may send and when, the words it avoids, and the confidence threshold below which it hands a chat to a person. An assistant nobody has edited reads as the defaults, with updated_at null. Read-only.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: get_assistant_persona
title: Read the AI assistant’s persona
